pages.name: Sea Bee
pages.text: Bubba Star. Overworld, by day (also works in rain).

Ocean bees can't dive, so they use flowers they can reach from above: sea pickles on land, kelp at the surface. Rarely brings home a nautilus comb.$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() Sea Pickle, Kelp, Kelp Plant, Seagrass, Tall Seagrass$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() Beach, Snowy Beach, every ocean

$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)Sea Honeycomb: the other trips, 200 per hive-hour$(li)Nautilus Honeycomb: rare, 1 in 20, 10.5 per hive-hour$(br2)$(l)Water-safe:$() Works in the rain and takes no damage from water.
Use it on a vanilla bee.
